newsitem.title: ITALY: Employment in big Italy firms -3.7 pct yr/yr March.
newsitem.headline: Employment in big Italy firms -3.7 pct yr/yr March.

text.p: Employment in Italian industrial firms with more than 550 employees fell 3.7 percent year-on-year in March, the national statistics institiute Istat said.
Its employment index for the sector stood at 96.5 (1995=100) in March, with month-on-month employment up 0.1 percent from February.
Hours worked per employee were down 4.7 percent compared to March 1996, due to there being one working day less in March 1997.
Istat said all sectors except manufacturing industry were affected in March by the fall in employment. -- Rome newsroom +39 6 678 2501
